d:
Gold mining runs deep in these families, but keeping a legacy alive is never easy. Across generations, fathers, sons and relatives face tough decisions, clashing ambitions and pressure to prove themselves in the unforgiving goldfields. When family loyalty meets the hunger for gold, who will stand together and who will turn against their own?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 3, Episodes 2, 5, 11 and 15; and Season 6, Episodes 4, 7, 8, 10 and 16, on Discovery Channel India.
